presentation_title: Chain-of-Thought (CoT): Asking the AI to "Think Step-by-Step"
learning_objectives: By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to use Chain-of-Thought prompting to get better responses from AI models.
outline: Understanding the problem of brief AI responses
Example 1: Prompt without CoT and its result
Example 2: Prompt with CoT and its detailed result
Other ways to ask for step-by-step thinking
prerequisites: Basic understanding of AI chatbots and how to write simple prompts.

slides.title: Welcome
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Chain-of-Thought, or CoT, prompting. Here, we will learn how to ask AI to 'Think Step-by-Step'. This helps AI give more detailed and correct answers.
slides.image_prompt: A welcome screen with 'Chain-of-Thought Prompting' title, gears turning, and a friendly AI icon.

slides.title: Learning Objective
slides.narration: After this tutorial, you will be able to use Chain-of-Thought prompting. This will help you get detailed and correct answers from AI tools.
slides.image_prompt: A lightbulb icon with a checklist, representing learning and objectives.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you need a web browser like Chrome or Firefox. You also need an active internet connection. Access to an AI chatbot like ChatGPT or Google Gemini will help you practice.
slides.image_prompt: Icons for a web browser, an internet connection, and a generic AI chatbot.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: Before starting, you should know what AI chatbots are. You should also know how to write simple questions, called prompts, to get basic answers from these tools.
slides.image_prompt: A person thinking with question marks, leading to a simple AI chatbot icon.

slides.title: Have you ever got a short or incomplete answer from an AI?
slides.narration: Have you ever asked an AI a question and got a very short or confusing answer? Sometimes, the AI gives only one line when you need a detailed explanation. This can be a problem.
slides.image_prompt: A person looking confused at a computer screen displaying a very short, unhelpful AI response.

slides.title: Introducing Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
slides.narration: This happens because the AI does not understand that it needs to think step-by-step. Chain-of-Thought, or CoT, prompting helps the AI to 'think' before giving the final answer.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation of a thought process, perhaps a brain icon with arrows showing steps.

slides.title: What is Chain-of-Thought?
slides.narration: CoT means asking the AI to break down a problem and explain how it got the answer. It is like asking someone to show all steps in a math problem, not just the final answer.

slides.title: Let's try an example (Bad Prompt)
slides.narration: Let's understand this with an example. Open your chatbot. Ask the AI: 'Explain the water cycle.' Type this prompt in the message box and submit it.
slides.image_prompt: A simple text prompt 'Explain the water cycle' displayed on a chat interface.

slides.title: Bad Prompt - Result
slides.narration: The AI will give a very short answer. For example: 'The water cycle is the continuous movement of water on, above, and below the surface of the Earth.' This answer is correct, but it is not detailed.
slides.image_prompt: A chat interface showing the short AI response to 'Explain the water cycle'.

slides.title: Now, let's use CoT (Good Prompt)
slides.narration: Now, let's add 'Think step-by-step' to our prompt. Ask the AI: 'Think step-by-step and explain the water cycle in detail.' Type this prompt in your chatbot and submit it.
slides.image_prompt: A chat interface showing the prompt 'Think step-by-step and explain the water cycle in detail'.

slides.title: Good Prompt - Result (Part 1)
slides.narration: Notice the difference. The AI now gives a more structured and detailed answer. It starts by listing the main stages like Evaporation, Condensation, and Precipitation. Look at this result on your screen.
slides.image_prompt: A chat interface showing the start of a detailed AI response, listing stages of the water cycle.

slides.title: Good Prompt - Result (Part 2)
slides.narration: The AI then explains each stage clearly. For example, 'Evaporation: The sun heats water in oceans, rivers, and lakes, turning it into vapor.' This makes the explanation easy to understand.
slides.image_prompt: A chat interface showing the detailed explanation of 'Evaporation' and 'Condensation' from the AI.

slides.title: Why CoT works
slides.narration: CoT prompting works because it makes the AI process information in a logical way. It breaks down big tasks into smaller, easy steps. This gives us better quality answers.
slides.image_prompt: A visual metaphor of a complex puzzle being broken into smaller, solvable pieces.

slides.title: Other ways to ask for CoT
slides.narration: You can use other phrases too, not just 'Think step-by-step'. Try 'Walk me through your reasoning', 'Explain your thought process', or 'Break this down for me'. You can try these different options.
slides.image_prompt: A list of alternative phrases for CoT prompting, like a bulleted list on a whiteboard.

slides.title: When to use CoT
slides.narration: Use CoT when you need detailed explanations or logical thinking. It is very useful for coding, finding errors, or understanding difficult topics.
slides.image_prompt: Icons representing coding, problem-solving, and learning.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration: In this tutorial, we learned about Chain-of-Thought, or CoT, prompting. We saw how adding 'Think step-by-step' helps AI give detailed and logical answers. This makes AI responses better.
slides.image_prompt: A summary slide with key takeaways: 'CoT prompting', 'Think step-by-step', 'Detailed answers'.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration: For your assignment, open an AI chatbot. First, ask it: 'Explain how a car engine works' without CoT. Then, ask the same question using 'Think step-by-step'. Compare the two answers and see the difference.
slides.image_prompt: A person using a laptop, with a thought bubble showing a car engine and 'Think step-by-step'.
